description: This file provides support for the OpenAI 'o1/o3' model family within the litellm library. It defines a configuration class for these models, handles translation of messages, manages supported parameters, and includes model-specific logic like mapping parameters and recognizing model types.

classes.name: OpenAIOSeriesConfig
classes.description: A configuration class for OpenAI o-series models, extending OpenAIGPTConfig with additional methods for parameter management and message translation tailored for o1/o3 models.

methods.name: get_config(cls)
methods.description: Returns configuration settings by calling the superclass method.

methods.name: List[AllMessageValues] translate_developer_role_to_system_role( self, messages: List[AllMessageValues] )
methods.description: Returns messages as-is, supporting 'developer' role in o-series models.

methods.name: list get_supported_openai_params(self, model: str)
methods.description: Retrieves and filters supported OpenAI parameters based on model capabilities.

methods.name: map_openai_params( self, non_default_params: dict, optional_params: dict, model: str, drop_params: bool, )
methods.description: Maps and validates openai parameters, especially 'max_tokens' and 'temperature'.

methods.name: bool is_model_o_series_model(self, model: str)
methods.description: Determines if a given model string corresponds to an o1/o3 model.

methods.name: Coroutine[Any,Any,List[AllMessageValues]] _transform_messages( self, messages: List[AllMessageValues], model: str, is_async: Literal[True] )
methods.description: Transforms messages to accommodate model quirks, such as role translation and support checks, supporting both sync and async modes.
